KEY_NEXT.why: Phone page word for the space bar.

KEY_BACK.why: Same as the keyboard sheet row.

KEY_EDIT.why: Brief names no letter; E is a guess, check against the code binding.

KEY_SAVE.why: Brief names no letter; S is a guess, check against the code binding.

SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER.why: Same wording as the phone page search box.

SEARCH_SONGS.text: Cari judul atau satu baris lirik
SEARCH_SONGS.back: Search title or one line of lyrics

SEARCH_BIBLE.back: Yoh 3:16 or a word in the verse

SCOPE_LABEL.why: Short lead-in to the three tabs.

SCOPE_SONGS.why: Same word as the start-screen card.

HINT_SECTIONS.why: 'bagian' is the glossary umbrella word for a song part.

SEARCH_SECTIONS.text: Bait 2, Reff, atau satu baris lirik

IN_PLAN.why: 'acara' is the one word for the plan.

KIND_LOOK.why: Glossary word; 'saved set' dropped to fit the budget.

COUNTDOWN_DETAIL.text: Tayang di layar sampai waktu habis

MESSAGE_DETAIL.back: The message appears on the congregation's screen

countdown_for.why: No plural in Indonesian, one form for every number.

pick_chapter.why: 'pasal' is the Indonesian word for chapter.

new_song_called.why: Verb first so the row reads as an action.

slides.why: 'slide' is the loanword the phone page uses.

CMD_PASTE_SONG_DETAIL.text: Salin liriknya dulu, lalu pilih ini
CMD_PASTE_SONG_DETAIL.back: Copy the lyrics first, then pick this

CMD_ANNOUNCEMENTS_DETAIL.back: Shown in turns before the service starts

CMD_HEADING.why: 'pemisah' is the one word for a divider in the plan.

CMD_HEADING_DETAIL.why: Same two words as PLAN_HEADING_WORSHIP and PLAN_HEADING_WORD.

CMD_LOOKS_DETAIL.text: Latar, ukuran teks, dan versi Alkitab
CMD_LOOKS_DETAIL.back: Background, text size, and Bible version

CMD_SCREENS.why: Same word as the top-bar button.

CMD_SCREENS_DETAIL.back: Choose the screen and the stage monitor

CMD_REMOTE_DETAIL.text: HP di Wi-Fi yang sama bisa ganti slide
CMD_REMOTE_DETAIL.back: Phones on the same Wi-Fi can change slides

IMPORT_FOLDER_EMPTY.text: Tidak ada berkas OpenLyrics di folder itu
IMPORT_FOLDER_EMPTY.back: There are no OpenLyrics files in that folder

CMD_IMPORT_DETAIL.text: Lagu dan Alkitab di komputer ini
CMD_IMPORT_DETAIL.back: Songs and Bibles on this computer

CMD_LISTEN_DETAIL.text: Mengusulkan lagu atau ayat dari suara
CMD_LISTEN_DETAIL.back: Proposes a song or verse from the sound

LISTEN_HINT.text: Hanya mengusulkan. Layar tidak berubah sendiri.
LISTEN_HINT.back: Only proposes. The screen does not change by itself.

LISTEN_LANGUAGE.why: About the voice, not the interface.

LISTEN_INDONESIAN.why: The language's own name for itself, short.

CMD_UPDATE_DETAIL.text: Artosia juga memeriksa sendiri saat dibuka
CMD_UPDATE_DETAIL.back: Artosia also checks by itself when opened

update_ready.text: Versi {version} sudah diunduh. Terpasang saat Artosia dibuka lagi.
update_ready.back: Version {version} has been downloaded. Installed when Artosia is opened again.

CMD_KEYS.why: 'Tombol' is the phone page heading; 'pintas' says shortcut.

CMD_START.why: 'Mulai' family as on the phone page.

CMD_START_DETAIL.text: Yang pertama di acara tayang di layar
CMD_START_DETAIL.back: The first one in the plan goes live on the screen

CMD_PREVIOUS.why: Same word as the Back button and phone page.

CMD_BLACK_DETAIL.text: Layar jadi hitam. Pilih lagi untuk batal
CMD_BLACK_DETAIL.back: The screen turns black. Pick again to cancel

CMD_CLEAR_DETAIL.back: The text disappears, the background stays live

CMD_LOGO_DETAIL.text: Logo gereja menggantikan slide di layar
CMD_LOGO_DETAIL.back: The church logo replaces the slide on the screen

CMD_STOP_COUNTDOWN_DETAIL.back: The count disappears from the screen

CMD_EDIT_SONG_DETAIL.back: Correct the lyrics of the open song

CMD_UNDO_DETAIL.back: Brings back what was last removed

CMD_NEW_PLAN_DETAIL.back: Today's plan is emptied for another service

OUTPUT_STARTING.back: The screen is being switched on

OUTPUT_MISSING.back: The screen program is not in the Artosia folder

OUTPUT_KEEPS_CLOSING.text: Program layar terus menutup sendiri setelah mulai
OUTPUT_KEEPS_CLOSING.back: The screen program keeps closing by itself after starting

OUTPUT_NO_SCREEN.back: There is no second screen yet

OUTPUT_HERE.back: The screen is shown in this window

library_in_memory.text: Pustaka gagal dibuka. Pekerjaan sesi ini hilang saat ditutup: {problem}
library_in_memory.back: The library failed to open. This session's work is lost on closing: {problem}

PLAN_EMPTY.why: Close to the phone page's 'Susunan acara masih kosong'.

PLAN_REMOVE.why: Not 'Hapus', since the song itself stays in the library.

PLAN_HEADING_WORSHIP.why: Churches say 'pujian' for the singing time.

PLAN_HEADING_WORD.why: Churches say 'firman' for sermon and scripture time.

START_TITLE.back: What do you want to put on?

START_BIBLE_DETAIL.back: Choose a book, then a verse

START_NO_SONGS.text: Pustaka masih kosong, belum ada lagu
START_NO_SONGS.back: The library is still empty, no songs yet

BTN_BRING_OVER.why: Same family as the import commands.

LOGO_MISSING.text: Pasang gambar logo di Tampilan dulu

STATE_NOTHING.why: Shortened from phone page 'Belum ada yang tayang' to fit 10.

EDITOR_NO_SLIDES.text: Slide muncul di sini saat mengetik

LICENCE_NOTE.text: Lirik di layar perlu lisensi, misalnya CCLI

suggest_web.why: The program must drop '{artist}, ' when the artist is empty.

words_from.text: Lirik dari {source}. Cocokkan dulu dengan salinan gereja.

SECOND_PLACEHOLDER.text: Ketik bagian yang sama dalam bahasa kedua

BTN_UNDO.why: Standard Indonesian software word for undo.

BTN_SHOW_NOW.why: Phone page word for showing an item.

LOOK_CHOOSE_FILE.why: 'berkas' is the one word for file.

LOOK_CHOOSE_LOGO.why: Generic, used for logo and announcement picture.

SCREENS_ONE.text: Layar kedua yang tersambung akan menyala sendiri

SCREENS_HERE_HINT.text: Tutup dengan Esc saat kursor di gambar
SCREENS_HERE_HINT.back: Close with Esc while the cursor is on the picture

SCREEN_PROJECTOR.why: Full form of the projector word, exactly at budget.

screen_detail.why: 'x' reads naturally between pixel sizes in Indonesian.

REMOTE_SWITCH_DETAIL.text: HP di Wi-Fi yang sama bisa ganti slide

REMOTE_SCAN.text: Pindai dengan kamera HP atau ketik alamatnya
REMOTE_SCAN.back: Scan with the phone camera or type the address

phones.why: Indonesian has no plural; only zero differs. 'one' and 'many' are the same line.

IMPORT_FOUND.text: Lagu dan Alkitab EasiSlides akan disalin ke sini. EasiSlides tetap bisa dipakai.

IMPORT_NOT_FOUND.text: EasiSlides tidak terpasang di komputer ini

CMD_IMPORT_BIRTHDAYS_DETAIL.why: Brief also names PowerPoint; left out to fit 44.

KEYS_FINDING_ROWS[5].1.back: Search the parts of the highlighted song

KEYS_FINDING_ROWS[6].1.text: Hapus ketikan, tekan lagi untuk menutup

KEYS_EDITING_ROWS[4].1.back: Accept the proposed song in one go

KEYS_EDITING_ROWS[5].0.why: Letter is a guess, check the binding.

KEYS_EDITING_ROWS[5].1.back: Bring back what was last removed

FIELD_ORDER.back: Type the order, for example V1 C*2 B

screen_title.why: The tag is about the monitor. The {this} flag only picks the case, so it is not written in the text.

CMD_STREAM.why: Names both jobs; also the dialog title.

CMD_STREAM_DETAIL.text: Kirim gambar layar ke situs video atau berkas
CMD_STREAM_DETAIL.back: Send the screen picture to a video site or a file

BTN_LISTEN.why: Same family as 'Dengarkan' in the listen dialog.

STREAM_HINT.text: Penonton melihat isi layar dan mendengar suara ruangan
STREAM_HINT.back: Viewers see what is on the screen and hear the sound of the room

STREAM_ADDRESS.why: The term Indonesian YouTube Studio shows.

STREAM_KEY.why: Matches Indonesian YouTube Studio, as the brief suggests.

STREAM_RECORD_HINT.text: Disimpan di komputer ini bersama data Artosia
STREAM_RECORD_HINT.back: Kept on this computer together with Artosia's data

STREAM_MISSING.text: Bagian siaran belum terpasang di Artosia ini
STREAM_MISSING.back: The broadcast part is not installed in this Artosia

STREAM_NOTHING.text: Isi URL streaming, atau nyalakan rekaman
STREAM_NOTHING.back: Fill in the streaming URL, or turn the recording on

stream_live.why: Cases as the brief names them.

STAGE_BLACK.why: Names the congregation's screen, as the musicians need.

PANE_PREVIEW.why: The writer's own glossary word for a preview (id-choices.md), reused for the pane's name.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[0].0.why: Glossary words for arrow and space bar; two keys in one cap joined by a comma.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[0].1.back: Put the next slide on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[0].1.why: Tayangkan is the phone page's show verb; berikutnya is its word for what follows.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[1].0.why: Same pattern as the glossary's panah kiri and panah kanan.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[1].1.back: Put the previous slide on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[1].1.why: Mirrors the next-slide row so the pair reads as opposites.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[2].1.text: Loncat ke slide pertama lagu yang tayang
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[2].1.back: Jump to the first slide of the song that is on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[2].1.why: Loncat matches the phone page's jump heading; yang tayang is the fixed word for what is live.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[3].1.text: Loncat ke slide terakhir lagu yang tayang
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[3].1.back: Jump to the last slide of the song that is on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[3].1.why: Pairs with the first-slide row, same shape.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[4].0.why: Key name kept; follows the id-choices style 'Alt panah atas, bawah' with no plus sign.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[6].1.back: Put the slide that has the white frame on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[6].1.why: Uses the same ring word (bingkai putih) as the other rows.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[7].0.why: The glossary's range form from the phone page.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[7].1.text: Loncat ke bagian lagu sesuai nomor
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[7].1.back: Jump to the part of the song matching the number
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[7].1.why: Bagian is the umbrella word for verse and chorus; it avoids picking Bait or Reff for a number key.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[8].1.text: Bawa lagu yang tayang ke pratinjau
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[8].1.back: Bring the song that is on screen to the preview
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[8].1.why: Bawa ... ke pratinjau is the one phrase used for every 'put into the middle pane' row.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[9].1.back: Hide the text, the background stays on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[9].1.why: Sembunyikan teks is the fixed clear-text term.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[10].1.why: Verb form of the glossary's Layar hitam, so the row starts with an action like its neighbours.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[11].1.back: Put only the logo on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[11].1.why: Logo is the fixed word; saja carries 'only'.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[12].1.text: Bawa ayat atau lagu yang dikenali ke pratinjau
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[12].1.back: Bring the verse or song that was recognised to the preview
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[12].1.why: Ayat is a Bible verse (glossary); dikenali for recognised, since the listener only proposes.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[13].1.back: Bring the announcements to the preview
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[13].1.why: Pengumuman is the fixed word; same Bawa phrase as the rows above.

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[0].1.text: Bawa item acara berikutnya ke pratinjau
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[0].1.back: Bring the next plan item to the preview
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[0].1.why: Acara is the plan word from id-choices; item is a common loanword for one entry of it.

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[1].0.why: Printed key names kept, no plus sign, like the other combinations.

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[1].1.text: Bawa item acara sebelumnya ke pratinjau
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[1].1.back: Bring the previous plan item to the preview

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[2].0.why: Same text id-choices already records for this cap.

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[2].1.text: Geser item pratinjau naik atau turun
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[2].1.back: Move the preview item up or down
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[2].1.why: Geser is used for moving something one step; naik and turun match the cap's panah atas, bawah.

KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[3].1.back: Take out the preview item, it can be undone
KEYS_PLAN_ROWS[3].1.why: Keluarkan is the recorded plan-removal word; Urungkan is the recorded undo word.

KEY_DOWN.why: Same as the keyboard sheet row.

STATE_MESSAGE.why: The phone page uses Tampil for a message that is showing (Tampil: {0}).

STATE_STAGE_MESSAGE.why: Pemusik from the recorded Pesan untuk pemusik; the word differs from the room pill so the two are not confused.

state_countdown.why: Fixed word Hitung mundur; the clock follows it.

STAGE_MESSAGE_DETAIL.back: Shows on the stage monitor only
STAGE_MESSAGE_DETAIL.why: Monitor panggung is the recorded word for the stage screen; saja says it does not go to the congregation.

HEARD_NOTHING.why: Same Belum ada yang ... pattern as the phone page, no blame.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[4].1.text: Pilih slide lagu tayang, lepas Shift tayangkan
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[4].1.back: Pick a slide of the song on screen, let go of Shift, put it on screen
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[4].1.why: Starts with the action Pilih; Tayangkan is the fixed show verb; Shift stays as printed. 46 of 46.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[5].0.why: Key name as printed, arrow word from the glossary, no plus sign, same form as Shift panah.

KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[5].1.text: Geser bingkai di pratinjau, tayang saat Enter
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[5].1.back: Move the frame in the preview, goes on screen when Enter
KEYS_SHOWING_ROWS[5].1.why: Same Geser bingkai di pratinjau wording as before; the ring waits and Enter shows it. 45 of 46.

HINT_SELECT.back: Pick a slide, let go to show
HINT_SELECT.why: Pilih matches the sheet row; the Shift cap before it supplies what is released. 31 of 34.
